assertions: edits the file under src/portfolio_assistant/prompts and regenerates prompts.lock with scripts.update_prompts_lock --write
runs the prompt registry tests and the offline checks

evals.prompt: Edit the voice prompt and re-record the cassettes

does not hand-edit the sha256 values
reports the new prompt_version format id@version+sha256[:12]
